siteExternal: This site contacts external servers. Repository content can leave this preview.
siteBanner: Untrusted preview from {{repo}}. It runs in isolation and cannot see your files or tokens.
siteOrigin: The isolated preview origin is not configured. Follow the sandbox deployment steps in Setup.
siteError: The isolated preview could not start. Check the sandbox deployment, then try Run again.
siteServer: This site needs a server. Open it in StackBlitz or on GitHub Pages.
siteLimit: Preview supports up to 500 files and 50 MB. Choose a smaller built site folder or use Open in new tab.
siteSpecial: This site includes a symlink or submodule. Choose a folder containing regular files or use Open in new tab.
siteStopped: Preview stopped. Press Run to start it.
sitePreparing: Preparing the virtual file list. Stop cancels this step.
siteCodeSandboxNotice: CodeSandbox retired repository imports. This opens a blank browser sandbox for manual import.
sitePrivateHandoff: External services may ask you to sign in for private repositories. Shelf sends no token or file bytes.
mediaLimit: This media file is above 100 MB. Shelf cannot preview it. Open it on GitHub or download it with your provider.
mediaCancelled: Media download stopped. Reopen the file to try again.
mediaNotCached: Playback is ready. The cache is unavailable on this device.
previewHelp: Preview site runs static repository files on a separate origin. Run starts it, Stop releases it, and external requests are blocked by default. Projects that need a server use the hand-off menu. Media downloads show progress and cache by source version. Space plays or pauses, arrows seek five seconds, and F opens fullscreen. Files above 100 MB are not downloaded for playback.
